title: EEVblog #147 - Agilent 3000 $12000 Smoke
notes: Episode frontmatter is missing the episode number.

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: playing around with this new Agyant 3000 series, and look, not it started to lock up

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: the menu options just did absolutely nothing

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: getting all this garbage and tearing on the display

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: something has gone horribly wrong with like the acquisition uh frame buffer

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: the capture engine, something like that

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: Let's try a reboot and see if it fixes it

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: these things take about 30 seconds to boot

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: the uh power switch is actually a real power switch

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: It's not just a soft module power switch

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: That characteristic electronic burning swell where the magic smoke has escaped

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: the first rule of troubleshooting is thou shalt check voltages

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: I've checked all the rails. There's plenty of different rails in this thing

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: it doesn't appear to be anything to do with the power supply

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: I'll just ship it back to Agyant with a big fail sticker on it

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: $12,000 scope, brand spanking, new out of the box, work for a little bit
